neighbours.label: domain and path tokens inside a web address, strongest on '.gov' (www.agency.gov/...), not the same institution named in plain prose
fire: The full rules are posted at http://www.epa.gov/water/rules for anyone curious.
Applicants should visit www.irs.gov/forms before the April deadline.
Maps of the park appear at http://www.nps.gov/yell/planyourvisit online.
You can check recalls at http://www.fda.gov/safety each week.
Census tables were retrieved from http://www.census.gov/data in June.
The weather office posts alerts on www.weather.gov/alerts during storms.
Our source is http://www.bls.gov/cpi, accessed in March 2015.
A list of grants is kept at http://www.nsf.gov/funding by the foundation.

notes: Card: '.gov' x17, '.net' x4, '/~' x3 in the top 32; max only 0.59, broad flag 1.5%. Probes: '.gov' 0.49-0.65, but '.edu' 0.31, '/news' after .org 0.37 and '/forum' 0.44, so it is not .gov-only; prose naming the agency stayed under 0.1.
